subject: Request: privilege boundary export + SCIM delta for SIG review
messages:
From: Caroline Reed <caroline@nebulahealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: security@nebulahealth.com
Date: Tue, 2 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: SIG follow-up — RBAC change history and SCIM delta

Hi Priyom / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As part of Nebula Health's SIG intake, our security team needs a few pieces of evidence to close the access-control section:

- RBAC change history covering 2026-11-01 through 2026-12-01 (who changed roles, what roles, and timestamps). CSV is preferred.
- SCIM delta export for the last 14 days (all adds/updates/deletes) with user IDs and external IDs.
- Short justification for any privileged accounts (roles with write/admin scope) that were active during that period — a 1-2 page doc is fine.

Can you confirm you can provide these by EOD Pacific on 2026-12-14? If not, propose a short mutual action plan (MAP) with dates. We can provide the SIG questionnaire meanwhile.

Appreciate the help — Caroline

--
Caroline Reed
Head of InfoSec, Nebula Health
caroline@nebulahealth.com
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Caroline Reed <caroline@nebulahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Dec 2026 09:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — RBAC change history and SCIM delta

Caroline — thanks for the clear list. We can get you those artifacts. Quick plan:

1) I'll own delivery and QA of the package.
2) Marcus will pull RBAC change history and SCIM deltas from our audit pipelines.
3) Laura will draft the privileged-account justifications (context, business need, and expiration/mitigation).

Target: deliver a single packet (CSV + JSONL + DOCX) to your shared Drive link by 2026-12-14 5:00 PM PT. If anything slips, we'll send an interim MAP by 2026-12-10 with exact dates.

Marcus — can you confirm the RBAC export will include: actor, target_user_id, previous_role, new_role, timestamp, and the resource scope? Also please include the change reason field if available.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
pri@redwood.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Caroline Reed <caroline@nebulahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — RBAC change history and SCIM delta

Priyom / Laura / Caroline — attaching the exports. Notes below.

Attachments: rbac-change-log-2026-11-to-2026-12.csv (CSV, redacted PII), scim-delta-20261201-20261214.jsonl (JSONL), privileged-accounts-justification.docx (Word)

Summary of what I pulled:
- RBAC CSV includes columns: actor_email, actor_id, target_user_email, target_user_id, previous_role, new_role, resource_scope, timestamp_utc, change_reason. We redacted personal IDs to internal hashes per Nebula NDA.
- SCIM delta is a newline-delimited JSON export from our provisioning sync: event_type (create/update/delete), scim_id, external_id, user_name, email, timestamp_utc. We filtered to the 2026-12-01 — 2026-12-14 window requested.
- Privileged accounts doc lists the 9 accounts with admin/write privileges currently active, their business owner, justification, and planned deprovision date where applicable. We included temporary exception tickets for 3 accounts.

A couple of operational notes:
- RBAC change_reason is free text from audit UI; some older changes may be empty.
- SCIM delta includes provisioning events from Okta -> Redwood; it does not include manual local user edits — those are in RBAC change history.
- Let us know if you need raw log exports instead (we can provide an S3 link under NDA but that will take extra sign-off).

- Marcus
Marcus Lin
Security Engineer, Platform
Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

If everything looks good, Laura will reply with the privileged-account summaries inline in the SIG template.

Thanks for the quick turnaround — looking forward to closing this section.

Best,
